description: This file contains test functions for the execute status update handler in a Go-based web service. It tests various scenarios including successful status updates, failure conditions, webhook integrations, invalid inputs, and concurrency control related to execution status management.

methods.name: TestUpdateExecutionStatusHandler_Success
methods.description: Tests that the handler correctly updates execution status to succeeded and associated fields.

methods.name: TestUpdateExecutionStatusHandler_Failed
methods.description: Tests the handler's behavior when updating the execution status to failed with an error message.

methods.name: TestUpdateExecutionStatusHandler_WithWebhook
methods.description: Verifies that registering a webhook triggers a notification upon status update.

methods.name: TestUpdateExecutionStatusHandler_InvalidStatus
methods.description: Checks that invalid status values result in a bad request response.

methods.name: TestUpdateExecutionStatusHandler_MissingExecutionID
methods.description: Ensures that a missing execution ID in the request path results in a bad request.

methods.name: TestUpdateExecutionStatusHandler_NotFound
methods.description: Tests handling when execution record is not found in storage.

methods.name: TestUpdateExecutionStatusHandler_ProgressUpdate
methods.description: Tests that progress updates do not change execution state to terminal.

methods.name: TestWaitForExecutionCompletion_Success
methods.description: Validates that waiting for execution completion succeeds and responds upon event publication.

methods.name: TestWaitForExecutionCompletion_Timeout
methods.description: Ensures timeout occurs if execution does not complete within the expected window.

methods.name: TestWaitForExecutionCompletion_ContextCancellation
methods.description: Checks that cancellation of context cancels the wait appropriately.

methods.name: TestWaitForExecutionCompletion_NoEventBus
methods.description: Handles the case where event bus is unavailable during wait.
